title: feat: complete P0/P1 spec compliance roadmap items
body:
Implements all Priority 0 and Priority 1 tasks from `ROADMAP_SPEC.md` — the UI-facing spec compliance milestones required for v1.0 release.

P0 items were already complete from prior work. This PR implements all P1 items and updates the roadmap.

### ListView spec properties (`@object-ui/types` + `plugin-list`)

- **quickFilters** — predefined filter toggle buttons in toolbar; conditions merged with user/base filters on fetch
- **hiddenFields / fieldOrder** — functional "Hide fields" popover replacing the disabled button; field ordering applied to all child view schemas
- **exportOptions** — CSV/JSON export with configurable formats, max records, filename prefix; proper CSV escaping (commas, quotes, newlines)
- **densityMode** — compact/comfortable/spacious cycle button wired to existing `useDensityMode` hook

```ts
// New ListViewSchema properties
quickFilters?: Array<{ id: string; label: string; filters: any[]; icon?: string; defaultActive?: boolean }>;
hiddenFields?: string[];
fieldOrder?: string[];
exportOptions?: { formats?: ('csv'|'xlsx'|'json'|'pdf')[]; maxRecords?: number; includeHeaders?: boolean; fileNamePrefix?: string };
densityMode?: 'compact' | 'comfortable' | 'spacious';
```

### Plugin enhancements

- **Gantt inline editing** (`plugin-gantt`) — `inlineEdit` + `onTaskUpdate` props; double-click task rows to edit title/dates; `toLocaleDateString('en-CA')` for timezone-safe date inputs
- **Map marker clustering** (`plugin-map`) — grid-based `clusterMarkers()` algorithm; auto-enables for >100 markers; cluster circles show count; reclusters on zoom via `onZoom`
- **Combo charts** (`plugin-charts`) — `chartType: 'combo'` with per-series `chartType` override; dual Y-axes (`yAxisId: left/right`)
- **Grid column persistence** (`plugin-grid`) — column order + widths saved to localStorage; restored on mount; `onColumnResize`/`onColumnReorder` callbacks on data-table schema
- **Detail inline editing** (`plugin-detail`) — `inlineEdit` + `onFieldSave` props on `DetailView`; edit/save toggle button; `isEditing`/`onFieldChange` passed through to `DetailSection`

### Other

- Fixed pre-existing `ObjectGalleryIntegration` test expecting Gallery empty text instead of ListView empty state
- Updated `ROADMAP_SPEC.md` — all P0/P1 tasks marked ✅ Complete with implementation notes
- 6 new tests covering quickFilters, hiddenFields, densityMode, exportOptions rendering
